red_observations.result: EXPECTED_FAILURE: both new tests showed missing per-phase completion/failure statuses, missing required phases, and no durable failing-phase attribution.

root_cause_and_fix.root_cause: handle_browser_failure used only the last completed application transition for diagnostic current_step and ignored active_step, so a failure during contact filling was mislabeled as the earlier completed upload phase.
root_cause_and_fix.fix: Failure diagnostics now use the active fixed phase, falling back to the last completed transition or UNKNOWN. The debug sanitizer allowlists the fixed FILL_LOCATION, ANSWER_STANDARD, and ANSWER_CUSTOM phase labels.
root_cause_and_fix.preserved_privacy: Attempt traces contain only fixed phase labels/statuses. Existing serialized and screenshot privacy canaries passed; answer values, form content, and exception text remain excluded.
root_cause_and_fix.mock_submission_boundary: One success path submitted only to the in-process MOCK fixture and verified its single local receipt. The interruption path produced no receipt. No real ATS, external submission, or external browser request was used.
